ValidationRule.description: Validates that the account Billing Country is a valid two -character abbreviation for US, USA, United States
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(BillingCountry = "USA", BillingCountry="United States", BillingCountry= "United States of America", BillingCountry= "united states")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A valid two-letter country code (US) is required for United States.
